snippet.title: Lup Salad: Lupupu Cube (ルプ・さらだ) - Story Mode 裏 100% Playthrough (All Puzzle Solutions)
snippet.description:
"裏 World", can be loosely translated to "Back World" / "Reverse World", is unlocked after beating story mode once. All the chapters are the same but the game gives a different set of puzzles to beat. These puzzles are definitely harder, and the game doesn't give hint anymore after retrying the stage. To clear 10 stages of chapter 1 it took me about 2.5 hours, whereas in the "normal" story mode, I could probably clear several chapters under the same time span. 

After being stuck 5 months earlier at Stage 4-8, I decided to give the game another try, and finally cleared all the stages after putting hours of trial and error. 

* For a fun fact, when playing 裏 World, the game automatically changes BGM setting from "Voice" to "Music." Maybe because it would take longer time to think and solve the puzzles in 裏 World rather than normal mode (表 World). 

* Stage 4-4 is also the first stage that I noticed that, even though I tried to finish the stage as quickly as possible, the BGM reached its end. This stage would serve as good example of how long the required solution to clear the puzzle in 裏 World. The other example is Stage 10-2.
